questions.text: We’ll be back at 17:00 instead. Is it okay to charge the car from 17:00 to 19:00 (3 kWh) to reach 80 % by 19:00? If not, when would you prefer to charge?
The house will warm from 17:00 to 22:00 as requested. Is there anything else you’d like to change?

explanation: The gateway has updated the schedule to reflect your return at 17:00 instead of 19:00. The house will warm to 22–23 °C from 17:00 to 22:00. The car will charge from 17:00 to 19:00 to reach 80 % by 19:00, using solar power and the battery to save costs.
